diff --git a/third_party/README.botan b/third_party/README.botan
index 6fab2ecee1f..ed166c45750 100644
--- a/third_party/README.botan
+++ b/third_party/README.botan
@@ -1,16 +1,25 @@
-Directory ./botan contains a copy of version 2.18.2 of the Botan library,
-which has been obtained from https://botan.randombit.net/releases/Botan-2.18.2.tar.xz .
+Directory ./botan contains a copy of the Botan library, which has been obtained
+from https://github.com/randombit/botan
 
 For licensing information, please refer to the included documentation.
 
-The SHA256SUM of the imported file is:
-541a3b13f1b9d30f977c6c1ae4c7bfdfda763cda6e44de807369dce79f42307e  Botan-2.18.2.tar.xz
+[tag 2.18.2]
+
+Updating:
+- cd $topsrcdir/comm
+- ../mach vendor -r <tag_name> third_party/botan/moz.yaml
+- Review the changes
+- Commit the changes
+
+The tag information in this file is automatically updated. The moz.yaml file
+is automatically updated. If upstream changes require updating moz.build, that
+must be done with a manual step.
 
 The following files were removed from the source distribution:
 .github/
 .gitignore
-.lgtm.yml
-.travis.yml
+.clang-format
+src/examples
 src/tests
 
 The following files were added to the source's root by MZLA Technologies:
diff --git a/third_party/botan/moz.yaml b/third_party/botan/moz.yaml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..929f49c6dbd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/third_party/botan/moz.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+---
+schema: 1
+
+bugzilla:
+  product: "Thunderbird"
+  component: "Build Config"
+
+origin:
+  name: "botan"
+  description: "Cryptography Toolkit"
+
+  url: "https://github.com/randombit/botan"
+  license: BSD-2-Clause
+
+  release: tag 2.18.2
+
+  revision: 2.18.2
+
+  license-file: license.txt
+
+vendoring:
+  url: https://github.com/randombit/botan
+  source-hosting: github
+  tracking: tag
+
+  skip-vendoring-steps:
+    - hg-add
+    - spurious-check
+    - update-moz-build
+
+  keep:
+    - botan.mozbuild
+    - botan_configure.py
+    - moz.build
+    - Makefile.in
+
+  exclude:
+    - ".*"
+    - ".github/**"
+    - "src/examples"
+
+  update-actions:
+    - action: replace-in-file-regex
+      file: '{yaml_dir}/../README.botan'
+      pattern: '\[tag [0-9\.]+\]'
+      with: '[tag {revision}]'
